intelligence.enrichment: Relative density with respect to water equals the density of a substance divided by the density of water at that temperature, so it is a number without units. Dividing one density by the reference density of water cancels the units and gives how many times denser the substance is than water. The learner correctly applies this rule: Relative density with respect to water equals the density of a substance divided by the density of water at that temperature, so it is a number without units. Relative density is another density measurement, so the answer should be written as 2.7 g/cm^3.
